info.name: Nexus #203 | Shipment status full AC evidence
info.description: Use the prepared issue203 runtime, import this collection and its four-token environment, paste your own login access tokens, then run folders 00-09 in order. All URLs, local carrier settings and fixture IDs are collection defaults. Buyer/actor IDs are extracted from JWTs automatically; no login request is automated. Seed resets only reserved issue203 fixture IDs. Evidence requests read actual shipment_db, Kafka and service logs through the companion. The external GHN provider is simulated locally; this is not a live GHN sandbox run. See ../README.md for AC-to-testcase and screenshot instructions.

exec: (function () {
const identities = [['accessTokenAdmin', 'adminActorId'], ['accessTokenSupport', 'supportActorId'], ['accessTokenBuyer', 'buyerId'], ['accessTokenOtherBuyer', 'otherBuyerId']];
for (const pair of identities) {
const token = pm.environment.get(pair[0]);
if (!token || !token.trim()) {
continue;
try {
let encoded = token.trim().split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
encoded = encoded.padEnd(Math.ceil(encoded.length / 4) * 4, '=');
const claims = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(atob(encoded).split('').map(function (character) { return '%' + ('00' + character.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join('')));
if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(claims.sub)) throw new Error('Invalid subject');
pm.collectionVariables.set(pair[1], claims.sub);
} catch (error) {
throw new Error(pair[0] + ' must contain the JWT access_token from your own login, with a UUID sub claim.');
const otherBuyer = pm.variables.get('otherBuyerId');
if (otherBuyer && otherBuyer === pm.variables.get('buyerId')) throw new Error('accessTokenOtherBuyer must belong to a different buyer.');

item.name: AC1-M01-E | One CREATED history and ShipmentStatusUpdated

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const b = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Evidence case identity', function () { pm.expect(b.caseId).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.orderId).to.equal('20310000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'); });

pm.test('Persisted shipment and history counts', function () { pm.expect(b.status).to.equal("CREATED"); pm.expect(b.historyCount).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.eventCount).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.receiptCount).to.equal(1); });
pm.test('Consumer idempotency and cancellation tombstone', function () { pm.expect(b.processedCount).to.equal(0); pm.expect(b.tombstoneCount).to.equal(0); });
pm.test('Actual CarrierAdapter cancellation calls', function () { pm.expect(b.cancelCalls).to.equal(0); });

pm.test('Server evidence assertions', function () { pm.expect(b.assertions).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(b.assertions.all, JSON.stringify(b.assertions)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(b.passed).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('Shipment version unchanged or changed exactly once', function () { pm.expect(b.version).to.equal(1); });

pm.test('History / event correlation', function () { pm.expect(b.history).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.events).to.have.lengthOf(1); const h = b.history[0]; const e = b.events[0]; pm.expect(e.topic).to.equal('nexus.shipment.events'); pm.expect(e.aggregateId).to.equal('20300000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'); pm.expect(e.payload.historyId).to.equal(h.id); pm.expect(e.payload.shipmentId).to.equal('20300000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'); pm.expect(e.payload.orderId).to.equal('20310000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'); pm.expect(e.payload.status).to.equal("CREATED"); pm.expect(e.payload.shipmentVersion).to.be.above(0).and.at.most(b.version); });
pm.test('Verified change source', function () { pm.expect(b.history[0].source).to.equal('CARRIER_WEBHOOK'); pm.expect(b.events[0].payload.source).to.equal('CARRIER_WEBHOOK'); });
pm.test('Correct Shipment event type', function () { pm.expect(b.events[0].eventType).to.equal('ShipmentStatusUpdated'); });
